themeTrustedRuntime.consentIntro: Authorization applies to this theme revision only. A new revision requires a new decision.

themeTrustedRuntime.enabled: This revision may request Trusted authorization
themeTrustedRuntime.disabled: Trusted mode disabled and existing user grants revoked

themeTrustedRuntime.warningTitle: Same-origin code can access this account's data
themeTrustedRuntime.warning: JavaScript from this revision can read or change this page, localStorage, and sessionStorage; observe input; call Yin APIs available to the current user; make network requests; or block the page. The Theme API permission list cannot restrict these same-origin abilities.
themeTrustedRuntime.serverBoundary: Theme JavaScript in the browser does not by itself gain access to the Yin-Panel server filesystem, Go process, or operating system. Server access remains subject to backend authentication and authorization.
themeTrustedRuntime.acknowledge: I trust this theme revision and understand it runs with this website's same-origin privileges.
